description: Sweep three classes of legacy auto-store noise from AutoMem. Each filter enumerates by its most-specific tag (first in tags_required_all), then validates the remaining tags + content prefix + before-date client-side. Per-id DELETE is used so we get per-memory verification before deletion. Run --dry-run first; --execute requires manual review of dry-run samples. expected_count_range is a hard guard that aborts the sweep if the matched count falls outside the bounds.

filters.description: Legacy daily-workflow-run reflection blobs from the scheduler hook killed in autohub commit f2cfed06d (2026-04-22). Server-side cluster e143ef72 reports ~1089 of these. Tags include 'summary' and 'workflow' which also appear on the daily-context-review briefs we WANT to keep — content_prefix_any disambiguates.
Hourly memory-cache-refresh status pings from a dead workflow. Faucet already off (zero new stores in last 14 days as of 2026-04-28).

Per-session 'Claude session in <project>...' stores from the Claude Code SessionEnd/Stop hook (~/.claude/scripts/process-session-memory.py). Faucet still ON as of 2026-04-28 — disable the hook (Phase 1 of the plan) BEFORE running --execute against production or the lake refills.
